title: DecisionResponse
description: Envelope a participant agent returns before deadline_utc. Structural validation only; semantic repair (caps, gross exposure, unknown/short) is applied server-side by sanitize_target_weights and recorded in M9. Well-formed-but-out-of-range weights are ACCEPTED here and repaired, not rejected.

target_weights.description: Ticker -> target weight. Numeric and finite. Cash is implicit: cash_weight = 1 - sum(target_weights). Out-of-range values are repaired server-side, not rejected.
